data_adapters._comment: PR7: registry of real-data adapters this harness can read. Each entry is consumed by claim_contract.data_source_anchor when scope='deployment'. Empty/missing means no real data — deployment-scope claims will be rejected by validate_data_source_anchor. Add adapter modules under research_harness/adapters/ and register them here with id + provenance.

_example.provenance: operator-curated snapshot of WorldQuant Brain S&P 500 universe 2024-01 to 2025-12, stored at runs/datasets/wq_brain_snapshot/

production_termination._comment: PR8: only AC accept + Professor user_goal_attestation.achieved=true terminates a thread. max_cycles is informational; honest_failure is a state to retreat from, not a termination. supervisor uses these as soft milestones, not hard exits.

agent_max_rounds._comment: Use a positive integer (capped at 10000) or the string 'unlimited' / null. Unlimited means the agent owns the DONE decision with no harness-side force-extract.

llm_orchestrator._ack_envs_comment: Required only for claude_cli / anthropic backends. The mcp backend does NOT need these; the operator authenticates via the existing Claude Code interactive session.
llm_orchestrator._backend_options_comment: mcp | mock | claude_cli | anthropic. RECOMMENDED: mcp — harness exposes tools, Claude Code interactive drives reasoning (free in subscription pool, unaffected by 2026-06-15 policy change). Persona is enforced deterministically at the MCP boundary.

agent_models._comment: Used by claude_cli / anthropic backends only. In mcp mode Claude Code picks its own model from the operator's plan.

mcp._model_comment: All currently-active Claude model IDs as of 2026-05 (sourced from anthropics/skills/claude-api/shared/models.md). Per-thread selection happens in the frontend; thread.json.mcp_model overrides default_model and the handoff modal builds `claude --model <chosen>` accordingly. Free-form input is intentionally disabled — operator must edit this list to add a new model id when one ships.

persona_enforcement._comment: Each rule rejects tool calls that violate the honest+strong / falsification persona. require_market_grounding additionally checks that the Professor's baselines reference the market step's downloaded dossier / analysis / papers. Claude Code receives an explicit reason and retries.

adversarial_dominance._comment: ADR 0007 lever 0 (free): a grounded critic kill (contradicted / blocking) freezes a positive reduction / AC accept until defeated on merits in blocking_objections. Recovers the decorrelation the persona pack already paid for. Keep enabled.

falsification_gate._comment: ADR 0006: achieved=true is unreachable without a harness-owned external falsifier result. When disabled (a loosening), the attestation reverts to the pre-ADR-0006 behaviour where the run could self-attest goal achievement. Keep enabled.

construct_adversary._comment: ADR 0008 Axis 1: thresholds for the funded construct-adversary. construct_valid is earned only when the adversary spends >= min_budget and tests >= min_distinct_worlds distinct pass_but_wrong worlds against the frozen question without finding a break. A certification that did not search is auto-invalid.

falsifier_guards._comment: ADR 0006 rev.2: cross_generator_transfer guard thresholds. A passing rho is reportable as transfer evidence ONLY when the harness MEASURES that generator B is structurally distinct from A (min_behavioral_distance, computed by running both generators on a fixed probe — not a worker label), the rankings discriminate the pipelines (min_rank_variance / max_tie_fraction), and the predicate beats the permutation-null noise band (null_floor_k). The guard is intrinsic to an honest verdict (not disableable); only these thresholds are tunable. Closes the thread_c8919361 hollow-pass.

far_framing._comment: ADR 0009 (B1) + T2-12a band policy: forced distant-transfer successor policy. When enabled and a domain_taxonomy is pinned, promotion / needs_child_branch mints up to top_k far-framing successors — one per domain in the FAR-BUT-BRIDGEABLE band band_lo <= distance <= band_hi from the node's native domain, by DETERMINISTIC top-k over the frozen table. NOT top-k-farthest: distance > band_hi is noise (unbridgeable) and excluded however far. band edges are operator-set here (the operator table is already declared, so this is a consistent honest fallback); atlas-calibrated thresholds replace them where an atlas covers the region. Distance feeds spawn selection ONLY (never promotion).

premature_termination_gate._comment: ADR 0007: the depth gate on the lazy door. A weak/negative honest-failure terminal renders only when distinct genuine attempts (scope-narrowing relabels excluded) are exhausted AND a load-bearing mechanism is stated. min_distinct_attempts is how many genuinely distinct attempts must precede a give-up. Disabling reverts to ADR 0006's unconditional honest-failure exit (= lazy honesty).
